questions.question: Use the check-supplier-invoice skill: can Zava Matériaux's invoice FA-2026-0217 be paid as it stands?

answer.text:
No — for **chantier Moreau**, Zava Matériaux’s invoice **FA-2026-0217** should **not be paid as it stands** as of the site-meeting action dated **24/03/2026**, because the delivery note records only **8 palettes received** for ZM-20450 while the invoice bills **10 palettes**.[1][2][4]

| Line | Billed | Received or ordered | Difference | Amount at stake HT |
|---|---:|---:|---:|---:|
| ZM-20450 — blocs béton creux | 10 palettes × 79,20 € HT = 792,00 € HT.[1] | Delivery note: printed 10 palettes, but OCR-read handwritten annotations state “reçu 8 pal.” and “2 palettes manquantes”.[2] | 2 palettes billed but not received.[1][2] | 2 × 79,20 € = **158,40 € HT**.[1][2] |
| ZM-31020 — mortier | 30 sacs × 7,90 € HT = 237,00 € HT.[1] | Delivery note indicates 30 sacs.[2] | No difference found.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| ZM-44108 — acier HA 10 | 24 barres × 9,45 € HT = 226,80 € HT.[1] | Delivery note indicates 24 barres.[2] | No difference found.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| ZM-27340 — linteau béton | 1 u × 164,00 € HT = 164,00 € HT.[1] | Delivery note indicates 1 u.[2] | No difference found.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |
| Frais de livraison camion-grue | 1 forfait × 65,00 € HT = 65,00 € HT.[1] | The delivery note identifies the vehicle as “camion-grue”.[2] | No difference found on the delivery-fee basis.[1][2] | 0,00 € HT.[1][2] |

The invoice total is **1 484,80 € HT**, **296,96 €** VAT at **20 %**, and **1 781,76 € TTC**.[1]  

The disputed amount is **158,40 € HT**, plus VAT **31,68 €** at 20 %, i.e. **190,08 € TTC**.[1][2]  

If the missing palettes are not regularised, the amount payable would be **1 326,40 € HT** and **1 591,68 € TTC** after deducting 158,40 € HT from the invoice total and recalculating 20 % VAT.[1][2]  

The purchase tracking records BC-2026-012 as ordered and invoiced for **1 484,80 € HT**, but it does not remove the delivery reserve on the 2 missing palettes.[3][2]  

The site-meeting minutes assign Bertrand Sauzède to verify FA-2026-0217 against the 13/03/2026 delivery note before payment, with a due date of 31/03/2026.[4]  

Because the delivery-note reserve is OCR evidence, the handwritten “2 palettes manquantes” should be checked against the scan or confirmed with Zava before payment.[2]

questions.question: Use the prepare-site-meeting skill to prepare site meeting no. 4 of the Moreau chantier on 7 April 2026.

answer.text:
Brief for **site meeting no. 4 — chantier Moreau — 07/04/2026**, prepared from the latest evidence I found: **planning PLN-2026-003 indice A dated 17/03/2026** and **site meeting minutes no. 3 dated 24/03/2026**.[1][2][3][4][5][6]

## 1) Progress by task — late / due before 07/04 first

- **T05 — Élévation des murs** was planned from **16/03 to 27/03/2026** and was only **20 %** complete in planning indice A, so it is the first point to review on 07/04.[1]  
- **T06 — Charpente, couverture et fenêtre de toit** was planned from **30/03 to 03/04/2026** at **0 %**; it includes **lot 4 and avenant n°1**, so check whether the roof-window amendment work is actually done.[1]  
- **T07 — Livraison des menuiseries** was planned for **30/03/2026** at **0 %**, linked to **BC-2026-009**, so confirm whether the external joinery arrived before the meeting.[1]  
- **T08 — Pose des menuiseries** was planned from **31/03 to 02/04/2026** at **0 %**, so verify whether installation was completed or postponed.[1]  
- Tasks scheduled to start on the meeting date are **T09 — Électricité 1er œuvre** from **07/04 to 10/04/2026** and **T10 — Ouverture du mur existant** from **07/04 to 09/04/2026**, both shown at **0 %** in planning indice A.[1]  

## 2) Decisions from site meeting no. 3 to confirm on 07/04

- **D1:** temporary closing of openings with wooden panels is planned on **07/04/2026** so that extension insulation can start on **13/04/2026**.[2]  
- **D2:** kitchen renovation was brought forward, with removal and plumbing from **07/04 to 10/04/2026**, with client agreement.[3]  
- **D3:** the existing-wall opening / liaison bay was postponed until after joinery installation, now **27/04 to 29/04/2026**.[4]  
- **D4:** réception des travaux remains scheduled for **15/05/2026**.[5]  

## 3) Open actions from the last minutes

- **Inès Roux** had to update **planning PLN-2026-003 to indice B** by **27/03/2026**; I did not find that indice B in the evidence returned, so this is the main document gap for the 07/04 meeting.[6]  
- **Bertrand Sauzède** had to check **Zava Matériaux invoice FA-2026-0217** against the delivery note of **13/03/2026** before payment, due **31/03/2026**.[6]  
- **Damien Pradère** had to confirm the electrical intervention of **07/04/2026**, due **31/03/2026**.[6]  
- **Famille Moreau** had to empty the kitchen furniture by **03/04/2026**.[6]  

## 4) Deliveries and schedule points to challenge

- The joinery delivery **T07** was planned for **30/03/2026**, and the downstream joinery installation **T08** was planned for **31/03–02/04/2026**; because D3 postpones the wall opening until after joinery installation, confirm at the meeting whether joinery delivery and installation are complete.[1][4]  
- The planning still shows wall opening **T10** on **07/04–09/04/2026**, but the later site minutes postpone the existing-wall opening to **27/04–29/04/2026**; this should be resolved by obtaining or confirming **planning indice B**.[1][4][6]  

## 5) Changes / amendments to follow

- **Avenant n°1** is included in the scheduled task **T06 — Charpente, couverture et fenêtre de toit**, planned **30/03–03/04/2026**, so the meeting should confirm whether the amendment work is complete.[1]  
- The kitchen works were brought forward to **07/04–10/04/2026** by the last minutes, while planning indice A still places **T12 — Cuisine : dépose et plomberie** on **27/04–30/04/2026**; this is another point requiring the missing planning indice B or a clear meeting decision.[1][3][6]  

## 6) Points to decide on 07/04

1. Has **planning PLN-2026-003 indice B** been issued, and does it replace the indice A dates for kitchen works and the wall opening.[1][3][4][6]  
2. Are **masonry T05**, **roofing / roof-window T06**, **joinery delivery T07**, and **joinery installation T08** complete or delayed.[1]  
3. Is **temporary closing of openings** ready to happen on **07/04/2026** before insulation starts on **13/04/2026**.[2]  
4. Is **Adatum Électricité** confirmed for the **07/04/2026** intervention.[6]  
5. Did the Moreau family empty the kitchen by **03/04/2026** so the brought-forward kitchen works can start.[3][6]  

## Gaps

- I did not find the expected **planning PLN-2026-003 indice B** in the evidence returned, even though the last minutes required it by **27/03/2026**.[6]  
- I did not find later evidence closing the four action items from the 24/03/2026 minutes, so they should be checked in the meeting.[6]
